title: Covalent organic frameworks for metal–gas batteries: fundamentals and applications
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00900F, Review Article
Zihao Wang, Chenhui Yan, Hui Peng, Imran Shakir, Guofu Ma, Yuxi Xu
This review presents recent advances in covalent organic framework-based functional materials for metal–gas batteries, including structural advantages, synthesis strategies, working mechanisms, as well as structure–property relationship.
